description: A SIS held off by the peer's reason 4, with no other link to wait for, asks again after the soft link maximum time.
note: Conn 1 binds SAP 5 for ARQ with node delivery confirmation and at 0 sends an S_UNIDATA_REQUEST for SAP 9 at 0.0.1.3 (U_PDU "ping"), as cas/make-caller-rejected: the SIS holds it and asks for a link (A-0008, A-0010), the CAS calls (link_state calling) and its PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST goes out at 75000, and cas.link_request/0.0.1.3 starts when that transmission ends at 80550 (B-0203, B-0400, C-1100). At 91000 0.0.1.3 answers PHYSICAL LINK REJECTED with reason 4, Too many active links (octet 34): the call has failed (B-0220), timer stopped, link_state unlinked, and the SIS holds off keeping the U_PDU, with no rejection to the client (B-0303, B-0028). The SIS cannot see when one of the peer's links closes, and this node has no other link or call whose end would make it ask again (B-0412), so it starts sis.held_off/0.0.1.3 with the soft link maximum time, here derived as six answer waits, 1233000 ms (B-0451, A-0014, A-0015, A-0321). The burst ends at 92000 with nothing queued. At 1324000 the timer expires with the U_PDU still waiting, so the SIS asks again: the CAS calls (link_state calling; Ed4 set, the peer's edition still unknown, B-0124, B-0408), LBT rule 1 applies since the last burst heard addressed only this node (K-0067, K-0068), contention 12000 ms, the request goes out at 1336000 with our C_PDU ID 1, and cas.link_request/0.0.1.3 starts when it has been sent, at 1341550. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15 then 4: contention waits 45000 then 12000 ms (K-0080). Settings: cas.max_links, cas.link_request_timeout_ms 60000, cas.link_request_retries and cas.first_data_timeout_ms 120000. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133). A CAS-1 C_PDU of one octet in a type 8 D_PDU fills a block exactly, C_PDU IDs from 0 in each node's own sequence (C-1040), EOW 0. The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived from the answer wait (A-0321).
